data.name: Akram
data.gender_notes: Akram is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elative of the Arabic root ك-ر-م (k-r-m), 'to be generous' — 'most generous'. Its root is ك-ر-م (k-r-m). A common Muslim given name. Akram is a Arabic name meaning “Most generous; most noble”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Akram expresses “Most generous; most noble”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Elative of the Arabic root ك-ر-م (k-r-m), 'to be generous' — 'most generous'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akram total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
